D: A pet detective hunts for the Miami football team's kidnapped dolphin mascot before the big game.
P: Serve the mains when Ace finds Snowflake in the yacht storage yard.
S: Crisp fried ham croquettes with a creamy centre, lime to squeeze over
Ham and béchamel thickened with plenty of flour, chilled overnight, shaped into logs, rolled in egg and breadcrumbs, fried at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Lime alongside.
the dozens of animals hiding in his flat

Honey and cinnamon shortbread cut into animal shapes and baked golden, half dipped in white chocolate and showered with rainbow sprinkles. Beat 150g soft butter with 80g caster sugar and 2 tbsp honey. Mix in 250g plain flour and 1 tsp cinnamon to a dough and chill 30 minutes. Roll to 4mm and cut with animal cutters. Bake at 170C for 10 minutes and cool. Melt 150g white chocolate, dip half of each biscuit and scatter with sprinkles. Set on baking paper.
Grilled pineapple, mango and papaya with lime honey and chilli salt
Pineapple, mango and papaya chunks threaded on skewers, grilled hot for a minute a side, brushed with lime juice, honey and a pinch of chilli salt.
M: Slow roasted citrus pork, ham, Swiss and pickles pressed until crisp
Pork shoulder marinated in orange, lime, garlic and oregano, roasted at 160C for 4 hours, sliced, layered in Cuban bread with ham, Swiss, pickles and mustard, pressed flat and toasted in butter.
Game day buffalo wings with blue cheese

Wings dried overnight and baked crisp, tossed in hot sauce and melted butter, with a chunky blue cheese dip and cold celery sticks. Pat 1.5kg chicken wings dry, toss with 1 tbsp baking powder and salt and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Bake on a rack at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Melt 60g butter with 125ml hot sauce and toss the wings through. Mix 100g crumbled blue cheese with 100g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo and lemon juice. Serve with celery sticks.
W: Tart lime custard in a cookie crust, topped with whipped cream

Biscuit crumb and butter pressed into a tin, condensed milk whisked with egg yolks, lime zest and juice, baked at 160C for 15 minutes, chilled overnight, whipped cream on top. Press 200g crushed biscuits mixed with 80g melted butter into a pie tin. Whisk a 395g tin condensed milk with 4 yolks, the zest of 2 limes and 125ml lime juice. Bake at 160C for 15 minutes, chill overnight and top with 300ml whipped cream.
K: White rum muddled with mint, lime and sugar over crushed ice, topped with soda

Mint and lime muddled gently with sugar, 45ml white rum, crushed ice, topped with soda water and stirred. For each drink, gently muddle 8 mint leaves with half a lime cut in wedges and 2 tsp sugar. Add 45ml white rum and fill with crushed ice. Top with soda water and stir from the bottom. Makes four.

Shape into logs, roll in beaten egg and breadcrumbs.

veg.make_ahead: Roll up to 1 day ahead, fry fresh

Marinate in the fridge.
Roast at 160C, then slice.
Layer the rolls with pork, ham, Swiss cheese, pickles and mustard.
Press in a pan with the butter until crisp.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Mix the orange and lime juice, crushed garlic, oregano and olive oil and toss through the portobello mushrooms.
Marinate in the fridge for at least 2 hours.
Roast the mushrooms at 200C for 25 minutes, then slice. Slice the smoked tofu thinly.
Spread the rolls with mustard and layer with the mushrooms, smoked tofu, Swiss cheese and sliced pickles.
Press in a pan with the butter until crisp on both sides.
Crush the biscuits, mix with melted butter and press into a pie tin.
Whisk the condensed milk with the egg yolks, lime zest and lime juice.
Pour in and bake at 160C.
Chill overnight.
Top with whipped cream.
